verdict.rationale: The evidence shows participants have some self-service access: they can track past and current market orders, submit sell-to-cover/sell-all/hold-all orders, receive payouts, and receive shared grant contracts. That implies an employee-facing interface, but nothing documents a portal showing grants, vesting progress, strike price, or outcome modeling. Missing for 10: an evidenced employee portal view of grants, vesting progress display, strike price visibility, exit/outcome scenario modeling, and independent corroboration.
